card.name: Linking words before PDE5 inhibitor examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (such as, including, for example, a colon) that come right before a named example drug, mostly PDE5 inhibitors like sildenafil, vardenafil or riociguat in interaction text.

modes.label: Such as / including
modes.description: The words 'as' or 'including' introduce specific drugs after a drug class name.
modes.example: nonspecific PDE-5 inhibitors (such<< as>> dipyridamole or theoph

modes.label: Colon or comma before a drug
modes.description: A colon or comma after a class name or 'for example' leads into the named drug.
modes.example: o PDE5 Inhibitor<<:>> sildenafil (Revatio ® ) when used

modes.label: Co-administration of
modes.description: 'with' or 'of' after co-administration leads into a named drug.

card.writes: It seems to shift the next word away from finance words like fund and toward a specific drug name, though the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug class is about to be followed by specific example drugs, especially erectile dysfunction and PDE5 drugs.
